mtf_ensemble_v1.name: mtf_ensemble_v1
mtf_ensemble_v1.cv_note: Walk-forward CV accuracy 99% is spurious: CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=3) re-trains on test fold causing in-sample leakage. True CV accuracy ~57-60%. OOS 61.4% is the reliable metric.
mtf_ensemble_v1.notes: MTF stacking ensemble (XGB+RF+LGB+meta-LR). 58Y XAUUSD, 164 features (base+extended+MTF), horizon=5. OOS accuracy=61.4% (p=0.0, N=1687) vs xgb_horizon5_v1=59.9% (+1.5pp). Staged: awaiting Sharpe-gate reconciliation. LEAKAGE BUG FIXED (2026-04-20): base learners now trained on X_fit (60%), OOF meta-features built on X_oof (20%), meta-LR calibrated on X_cal (20%). Previously cv=3 on CalibratedClassifierCV caused base models to re-train on the test fold, inflating walk-forward CV to ~99%. Fixed to cv=prefit with three-way split. pkl_format=stacking_dict — not a plain sklearn estimator. Regenerate pkl by running: python scripts/retrain_mtf_accuracy.py
mtf_ensemble_v1.leakage_fix_description: Three-way split: X_fit (60%) for base learner training, X_oof (20%) for OOF meta-features, X_cal (20%) for meta-LR calibration. All CalibratedClassifierCV calls use cv=prefit (no re-training on test data).
